title: Show why two correct Poisson marginals do not permit free conditioning
statement: Atm=1,d=2 draw independent B1,B2~Pois(1/2),H=1_(B=(1,0)),p=exp(-1)/2,p0=exp(-1). Set P(N=1|B)=p0+(H-p)/4 and otherwise drawN fromPois(1) conditioned!=1 independently ofB. N has EXACT Pois(1) marginal,A0=(N,0) exact product-Poisson source forP=(1,0),and B exact product-Poisson target forQ=(1/2,1/2). Yet P(B=(1,0)|N=Nprime=1)=[p0+(1-p)/4]/[2p0+(1-2p)/4]!=1/2. Thus conditioning both totals may bias target composition even with two exact whole Poisson marginals. This defeats that inference only, not structured de-Poissonization or exact coupling generally.
